rows.jp: 昼飯はやっぱりここで食べたいところだ。
rows.en: This really was the place to eat lunch.

ghs.en: In the end I wanted to eat lunch here.

rows.jp: 「よう、太一」

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Hoy, Taichi."

rows.jp: カレーパン桜庭だった。

ghs.en: It was "Curry Bread" Sakuraba.

rows.jp: 超辛いここのカレーパンが大好きだ。
rows.en: He loved the extra-hot curry bread they sold here.

ghs.en: He really loves the hyper spicy curry bread they served here.

rows.jp: 「人類滅亡してもカレーパン」
rows.en: “Humanity goes extinct, and you’re still eating curry bread.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Curry bread even with the fall of mankind."

rows.jp: 「……やらんぞ」

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "...have some."

rows.jp: 「いらんわい」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Don't want it."

rows.jp: 「これを食い尽くしたら、もう食い納めだしな」
rows.en: “Once I finish all this, that’s it. No more curry bread.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "If I eat this up, then I'll be eating the last ones."

rows.jp: 表情が曇った。

ghs.en: His face clouded.

rows.jp: その背後に、パンの詰まったケースがタワー状に積んである。
rows.en: Behind him, cases packed with bread were stacked into a tower.

ghs.en: And behind it, cases packed with bread where piled up into a tower.

rows.jp: 「……これいつ搬入されたやつだ？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...when did they bring these in?"

rows.jp: 「昨日じゃないか？」

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Yesterday didn't they?"

rows.jp: 昨日。

ghs.en: Yesterday.

rows.jp: 確かに半日でもパンの販売はある。
rows.en: They did sell bread even on half days.

ghs.en: Certainly today's a half-day but bread's still on sale.

rows.jp: 基本的に休日以外は食堂として機能しているのだ。
rows.en: Barring holidays, the place basically functioned as a cafeteria.

ghs.en: Fundamentally, holidays excluded, this cafeteria is always in operation.

rows.jp: 始業式であってもパンは搬入されている。
rows.en: Even on opening-ceremony day, they still delivered bread.

ghs.en: There was the opening ceremony, yet still bread was brought in.

rows.jp: そう。

ghs.en: Indeed.

rows.jp: つまり昨日まで、ちゃんと世界は維持されていたわけだ。
rows.en: So until yesterday, the world had still been ticking along.

ghs.en: Therefore, until yesterday, the world was being properly maintained.

rows.jp: 「にしても数が少ない」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Still, the number seems insufficient."

rows.jp: ケースの数は、いつもの十分の一もない。
rows.en: There weren't even a tenth as many cases as usual.

ghs.en: The number of cases seems not one-tenth of the normal.

rows.jp: 「始業式で半ドンだからだろ」
rows.en: “Because opening ceremony meant a half day.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Because the opening ceremony day is half vacation perhaps."

rows.jp: 「にしても……少ない」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Still... insufficient."

rows.jp: 「それにオレは、人類が滅亡したとは思っていない」
rows.en: “Besides, I don't believe humanity has gone extinct.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Besides, me, I don't think humanity has fallen."

rows.jp: 「なんだって？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Come again?"

rows.jp: 「恐らく、市民全員で隠れんぼをしているんじゃないか、というのがオレの予測だ」
rows.en: “My prediction is that every citizen in town is playing hide-and-seek.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "I dare say: couldn't this be but a city-wide game of hide-and-seek? And that is what I predict."

rows.jp: 「妄想だそれは」

ghs.en: Taichi: "That's delusional."

rows.jp: 「予測なんて言葉は使うな。おまえが考えて結論を出したみたいじゃないか」
rows.en: “Don't call it a prediction. That makes it sound like you thought about it and reached a conclusion.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "And those weren't the words of a prediction. You sounded like you gave it thought and made a conclusion, didn't you."

rows.jp: 「フッ……手厳しいヤツめ」

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Hu! ...fastidious this guy."

rows.jp: 「満足そうに微笑むな」
rows.en: “Don't smile like you're pleased with yourself.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Don'tcha smile all satisfied now."

rows.jp: 「だが気にすることはない」

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "But there is nothing to worry about."

rows.jp: 「時間が経てば、みんな戻ってくるはずだ。オレの計算によるとな」
rows.en: “Give it time and everyone should come back. By my calculations.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "With the passing of time, I expect everyone to come back. That's according to my calculations."

rows.jp: 「…………オレも脳天気だが、おまえは細胞レベルで脳天気だな」
rows.en: “...I'm pretty carefree myself, but you're carefree on a cellular level.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "......me's optimistic, but you are optimistic at a cellular level ain't ye."
Sakuraba: "Hu."

rows.jp: どうして傷ついた少年少女たちの中にコイツがいるんだろう。
rows.en: What was this guy doing among all those hurting boys and girls?

ghs.en: Why this guy is even around wounded boys and girls I don't know.

rows.jp: 本気で悩んでしまった。

ghs.en: That seriously worried me.

rows.jp: 桜庭がそんな俺にカレーパンを差し出す。
rows.en: Sakuraba held out a curry bread to me.

ghs.en: And Sakuraba presented this worried me with some curry bread.

rows.jp: 「食え」

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Eat."

rows.jp: 「いらん！」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Don't wanna!"

rows.jp: 撃墜。

ghs.en: Shot down.
